note: Generated by art/slice_pack2.py. Worn-proof crops (NOT shipped) for registering hair and open-shoe sprites to the head / feet they were painted on. proof_box = [x, y, w, h] of the crop in the worn sheet; offset = top-left of the item sprite (dist/assets/pack2/<file>) inside the proof crop, measured by masked RGB template matching of the sprite against the worn sheet (the two sheets are separate generations). registration.shift_vs_sprite_box = how far the item sits on the worn sheet from where it sits on the item sheet; band_offsets = best extra shift of the top/middle/bottom third alone (a measure of residual misalignment / shape difference); iou = overlap of the sprite with the proof pixels classified as the item; proof_item_uncovered = fraction of those proof pixels the sprite does not cover. Shoe pairs also list per-part offsets.
